description: Files ZedForge keeps and copies into the target deployment repo before every validation run. On each iteration Seed-DeploymentRepo.ps1 (1) installs the LATEST ZED (with this iteration's fixes) into the target via Install-Zed.ps1 -Force, then (2) overlays the kept files below. If a ZED change alters what any of these files must contain, update the kept copy here so it carries forward to future iterations.

files.why: Pre-filled pipeline catalog (static routing). Fill real pipeline ids before real triggers succeed.
